confirmed_rules.statement: [CHK-04-013, UI] Role owner co the sua Width/Height cua printarea qua inline editor; mutation Hasura update_printareas that chay va thanh cong voi gia tri so hop le.

[CHK-04-008, business decision] Khong validate boundary numeric (0/am/thap phan/so rat lon) cho Width/Height cua Printarea - day la quyet dinh san pham do priority rat thap, KHONG phai gap ky thuat can lam ro them.
[CHK-04-009, phan UI] Xoa 1 printarea dang gan cho 1 variant: printarea bien mat NGAY khoi bang Printareas; cell 'Custom Printareas' cua variant lien quan tro ve 'No printareas' SAU KHI RELOAD trang.

[CHK-04-009, phan API/DB - dong dut diem vi tri du lieu] Sau khi xoa 1 printarea dang duoc it nhat 1 variant tham chieu, lien ket cu KHONG nam o field flat variant.printarea_id (field nay luon la null) ma nam o bang rieng variant_printareas, noi row lien ket cu VAN TON TAI duoi dang orphan row (khong tu don dep). Day la vi tri du lieu THAT SU, khac voi mo ta ban dau cua PO ve 'field printarea_id'.

observed_behavior.statement: Duong ghi bat doi xung: printarea tao/sua qua Hasura _set, xoa qua REST DELETE; product base tao/sua qua REST hoan toan.

Client gui thang mutation Hasura table-level (insert_printareas/update_printareas) bang JWT user thuong; pham vi cot/hang duoc phep _set CHUA duoc verify (khong co negative/cross-tenant test) - da xac nhan them qua CHK-04-013 rang UI cho sua that (KB-076), nhung pham vi bao mat that su van CHUA kiem chung.
Cho phep trung Fulfilled key 'Front' giua 2 printarea, khong canh bao, ca 2 ton tai song song.

[CHK-04-009, phan API - LECH voi mo ta cua PO] Field FLAT variant.printarea_id LUON LA null trong MOI sample (33/33 lan doc, ca truoc va sau khi xoa printarea). Kien truc thuc te dung bang rieng variant_printareas: sau khi xoa printarea 13989 (DELETE 204), row (id=23540, printarea_id=13989) trong bang variant_printareas VAN TON TAI KHONG DOI qua 3 lan doc lai doc lap - day la ORPHAN FOREIGN KEY thuc su, KHAC voi mo ta cua PO ve field 'variant.printarea_id'. Xem conflict CONF-CHK-04-009-001 - VI TRI du lieu nay da duoc PO xac nhan trong lần khảo sát (xem confirmed_rules/KB-096); rieng cau hoi bug-vs-accepted van chua duoc tra loi.

[CHK-04-009, mo rong pham vi] Tren 1 product test co 1 printarea, 2 mockup da gan qua variant va 1 campaign lien ket: sau khi xoa printarea do, 2 mockup va campaign_products/need_sync duoc mo ta la 'khong doi'. Bang 'mockups' KHONG co field/FK nao toi 'printareas' (query field printarea_id tren mockups tra loi 'field not found') - mockup va printarea doc lap hoan toan ve schema, khac han quan he variant_printareas. Pham vi hep (1 product, chua re-query doc lap SAU DELETE trong chinh file network nay) - confidence LOW, KHONG nang cap.

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner); pham vi cot/hang duoc phep sua qua Hasura _set chua duoc verify boi negative/cross-tenant test nao - phan nay VAN DEFERRED cho toi khi TIB_USER_B_* duoc cung cap (theo de nghi cua PO), KHONG ket luan an toan hay khong.

xoa printarea KHONG anh huong mockup da gan (schema doc lap hoan toan) - pham vi hep, confidence LOW
sua printarea tren product base dang duoc campaign dung kich hoat canh bao 'Update campaign'; xoa printarea khong doi campaign_products/need_sync trong sample da test

risks.risk: Mutation sua Width bang gia tri chu tra HTTP 200 kem loi Postgres tho trong body ('invalid input syntax for type integer'); UI khong bao gi, lo engine DB (Postgres) va kieu cot (integer) cho user dang nhap.

Audit log printarea ghi 201 'lac quan' truoc/doc lap ket qua mutation that; ban ghi thao tac that bai (Width='abc') khong xuat hien trong modal Logs -> audit log khong dang tin de do lai thao tac loi.

[SEC-003, xac nhan lai ] Client ghi thang Hasura mutation voi _set tuy y tu trinh duyet cho ca Width/Height hop le (khong chi truong hop loi); pham vi cot/hang duoc phep sua CHUA duoc verify bang negative/cross-tenant test - be mat tan cong tiem an (privilege scope chua ro), VAN DEFERRED cho toi khi co TIB_USER_B_*.

Xoa printarea khong co dialog xac nhan / khong undo - de mat du lieu do thao tac nham. Sau xoa con de lai ORPHAN row trong bang variant_printareas (khong tu don dep) - vi tri du lieu nay da duoc PO xac nhan (KB-096), nhung chua ro day la bug can fix hay chap nhan duoc (xem CONF-CHK-04-009-001, muc 'needs').
Cho phep 2 printarea trung Fulfilled key song song khong canh bao - rui ro nha in nhan sai file in neu 'Fulfilled key' dung de map file.
Dialog canh bao hien i18n key chua dich ('product.printareas.edit_warning') thay vi text that, lap lai moi lan du da bam 'Got it' - trai nghiem kem, co the la bug l10n/state.

Modal 'Logs' chi ghi 4 loai su kien, tat ca thuoc ve printarea - moi thao tac khac tren product base hoan toan KHONG co dau vet trong Logs; xac nhan lai qua rang product_activities rong hoan toan qua GraphQL cho ca 3 loai update that (xem FEAT-08). Ket hop voi KB-035, audit trail cua toan bo product base khong day du va khong dang tin cay.
